result.instructions: Tools for Freightview, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Rate a 2-pallet LTL shipment from Chicago IL 60601 to Atlanta GA 30301 and list the quotes."; "Show our shipments that are still pending pickup this week."; "Track shipment 12345 and tell me the latest event.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Freightview data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run freightview_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run freightview_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run freightview_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. freightview_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: freightview_get_account_users
tools.title: List account users
tools.description: List the users on the Freightview account behind the API credentials. Freightview API: GET /account/users.

tools.name: freightview_get_account_locations
tools.title: List account locations
tools.description: List the saved locations (sites) on the Freightview account. Freightview API: GET /account/locations.

tools.name: freightview_get_account_carriers
tools.title: List account carriers
tools.description: List the carriers added to the Freightview account (carrier ids used in quotes). Freightview API: GET /account/carriers.

tools.name: freightview_get_carrier
tools.title: Get carrier metadata
tools.description: Get a carrier's name and its available services by SCAC code. Freightview API: GET /carriers/{scac}.

tools.name: freightview_search_shipments
tools.title: Search shipments
tools.description: Search shipments on the account, with filters and a continuation token for the next page. Freightview API: GET /shipments.

continuationToken.description: Token from the previous page's continuationToken.

carrier.description: Carrier name or code, as Freightview accepts it.

tools.name: freightview_get_shipment
tools.title: Get shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment: status, locations, items, selected quote, tracking and documents. Freightview API: GET /shipments/{shipmentId}.

tools.name: freightview_get_shipment_quotes
tools.title: Get shipment quotes
tools.description: List the quotes for a shipment, with quoteId, carrier, amount and expiry. Use quoteId to book. Freightview API: GET /shipments/{shipmentId}/quotes.

tools.name: freightview_get_shipment_tracking
tools.title: Get shipment tracking
tools.description: Get the tracking events of a shipment, optionally for one item. Freightview API: GET /shipments/{shipmentId}/tracking.

tools.name: freightview_create_ltl_shipment
tools.title: Create LTL shipment
tools.description: Create and rate an LTL shipment draft with quotes. Nothing is booked. Book a quote later with freightview_book_ltl_shipment. Freightview API: POST /shipments/ltl.

shipType.description: e.g. business dock, business no dock, residential.

origin.description: Pickup (origin) or delivery (destination) place. Other fields pass through to Freightview.

shipType.description: e.g. business dock, business no dock, residential.

destination.description: Pickup (origin) or delivery (destination) place. Other fields pass through to Freightview.

weight.description: Weight in pounds, including the packaging.

returnQuotes.description: Return the quotes in the response.

tools.name: freightview_create_parcel_shipment
tools.title: Create parcel shipment
tools.description: Create and rate a parcel shipment draft with quotes. Nothing is booked. Book a quote later with freightview_book_parcel_shipment. Freightview API: POST /shipments/parcel.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. us or ca.
ISO country code, e.g. us or ca.

type.description: "custom" for custom packaging, or a packaging type id from Freightview.

returnQuotes.description: Return the quotes in the response.

tools.name: freightview_create_truckload_shipment
tools.title: Create truckload shipment
tools.description: Create a truckload shipment draft with its stops and equipment. Nothing is awarded or booked. Freightview API: POST /shipments/truckload.

items.description: A pickup or delivery stop. Other fields pass through to Freightview.

type.description: Equipment type, e.g. dry-van-53, flatbed-48, refrigerated-53.

isLiveLoad.description: true when the driver waits during loading.

billTo.description: Bill-to account. Other fields pass through to Freightview.

tools.name: freightview_book_ltl_shipment

billTo.description: Bill-to account. Other fields pass through to Freightview.

booking.description: Booking body. quoteId is required; other fields pass through to Freightview.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user explicitly approved this action now.
